blocks.text: At JD Hardware, operated by JD Hardware Co., we aim to provide clear information about shipping costs, order processing and delivery throughout the United Kingdom.
We currently ship within the United Kingdom only.
International shipping is not available.
Delivery eligibility for individual products may depend on their dimensions, weight and applicable transportation restrictions.
Standard UK Shipping: FREE (£0.00)
There is no standard delivery charge for eligible orders within the United Kingdom.
Our daily order cut-off is 5:00 PM UK local time, Monday to Friday.
Orders placed after the cut-off or during weekends and bank holidays may begin processing on the next business day.
1–2 business days
3–5 business days
4–7 business days
Business days generally mean Monday to Friday, excluding applicable UK bank holidays.
Once payment has been authorised, we prepare your order for dispatch.
Processing may include order verification, product checks, packaging and carrier handover.
Delivery timeframes are estimates rather than guaranteed arrival dates.
Weather, carrier disruptions, bank holidays, address problems and other circumstances may affect delivery.
Your statutory delivery rights remain unaffected.
Where tracking information is available, we may provide it after dispatch.
Carrier tracking systems may require additional time to display updates.
Products such as greenhouses, gazebos, saunas, fireplaces and heavy outdoor equipment may require specialised handling.
Any product-specific delivery restrictions or additional conditions will be disclosed before purchase.
Please provide a complete and accurate delivery address.
If you notice an error, contact us promptly.
If your order has not arrived within the expected period, email info@jdhardware.shop with your order number.
We will review the shipment and assist with the appropriate resolution.
If your product arrives damaged or incorrect, contact us as soon as reasonably possible.
Include photographs and relevant order details where available.
Under applicable UK consumer law, additional delivery, cancellation and refund rights may apply.
Nothing in this policy limits those rights.

blocks.text: At JD Hardware, we aim to make returning eligible products straightforward and transparent.
This policy applies to eligible purchases from https://jdhardware.shop.
Policy
Details
28 days
United Kingdom
Accepted
Accepted
Accepted for eligible products
By post
Provided by JD Hardware
Exchanges
Not available
Refund
Eligible products may be returned within 28 days of delivery under our standard store policy.
Please contact us within this period to request return instructions.
We accept eligible returns where a customer changes their mind.
Customers should take reasonable care of the product and return it with the original packaging and included accessories where possible.
Products may be inspected as reasonably necessary to establish their nature, characteristics and functionality.
If your product is faulty, damaged, not as described or otherwise fails to meet applicable legal requirements, contact us.
Your statutory rights may provide additional remedies beyond our standard 28-day policy.
If we supply the wrong item, please contact us with your order number and product details.
We will review the matter and arrange an appropriate resolution.
JD Hardware provides a return label for eligible returns.
Return Shipping Cost: £0.00
We do not charge restocking fees.
Restocking Fee: £0.00
Direct exchanges are not available.
If you want a different product, you may return an eligible item for a refund and place a new order.
This does not restrict statutory rights to repair or replacement where applicable.
1. Email info@jdhardware.shop or contact live chat.
2. Provide your order number and reason for return.
3. Wait for return instructions and the applicable return label.
4. Securely package the item.
5. Send the product to the authorised return address.
6. Retain proof of postage.
7. Await confirmation and the applicable refund.
For standard non-defective returns, products should be returned in reasonable condition with applicable accessories.
Any reduction in value caused by handling beyond what is reasonably necessary may affect the refund where legally permitted.
Certain goods may be subject to legally permitted cancellation exceptions, including some personalised or sealed hygiene-sensitive products.
Any applicable exception should be disclosed before purchase.
For most UK distance purchases, customers have a statutory 14-day cancellation period beginning the day after delivery, with a further 14 days to send goods back after notifying the trader.
Our 28-day store policy provides an additional return option but does not remove these statutory rights.
Under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, customers may have rights to reject faulty goods, request repair or replacement, or obtain an appropriate price reduction or refund.
These rights are not limited to our standard return window.
We aim to process eligible refunds within 10 days after receiving and approving a return.
Where statutory cancellation rights apply, refunds will be issued within the legally required timeframe, including where the law requires payment before our internal review is complete.
Do not send products to our business address without prior confirmation.
We will provide the correct return address and instructions.

blocks.text: We aim to process eligible refunds within 10 days after the returned product has been received and approved.

Where goods have not yet been delivered, applicable statutory refund deadlines will be followed.
Refunds are normally issued to the original payment method unless another method is expressly agreed where legally permitted.

Where permitted by law, a reduction may apply if a returned non-defective product has lost value due to handling beyond what was necessary to inspect it.
Any such reduction will be explained.
Refunds generally reflect the amount actually paid, subject to applicable statutory requirements.
If your refund has not appeared after processing:

items: Contact your bank or payment provider.
Email our support team with your order number.

blocks.text: Cancelling an Order at JD Hardware
We understand that customers may need to cancel an order.
Please contact us as soon as possible if you wish to cancel.
If your order has not been dispatched, contact us with your order number.
We will review its status and process the cancellation where applicable.
If your order has already been dispatched, it may not be possible to stop delivery.
However, this does not remove your statutory cancellation rights.
For most online purchases in the United Kingdom, consumers may cancel within 14 days beginning the day after delivery.
You do not normally need to provide a reason.
Certain legally defined exceptions may apply.
Contact us by email, telephone or live chat.
Include:

items: A clear statement that you wish to cancel

blocks.text: Where goods have already been delivered, you may need to return them.
JD Hardware provides free return labels for eligible returns.
Cancellation refunds are issued in accordance with applicable UK consumer law and our Refund Policy.
Contact us immediately to request a change.
Changes may not be possible after dispatch.

Standard delivery throughout the United Kingdom is free.

We encourage customers to complete purchases through our official website.

blocks.text: Product Support at JD Hardware
JD Hardware provides assistance with product enquiries, damaged deliveries, defects and applicable warranty information.
Warranty coverage may vary depending on the product and manufacturer.
Where a manufacturer warranty applies, its terms may specify the duration, covered defects and claim procedure.
Manufacturer warranties are separate from your statutory rights.
Under the Consumer Rights Act 2015, goods must meet applicable requirements, including satisfactory quality, fitness for purpose and correspondence with their description.
Customers may have rights to a refund, repair, replacement or other remedy depending on the circumstances.
If your product develops a fault, contact our support team.
Provide:
For electronics, gaming consoles, monitors, computer components and similar products, review compatibility and manufacturer documentation.
Always follow the manufacturer's safety, maintenance and operating instructions.
Heating products may require professional installation and compliance with applicable building, ventilation and fire safety requirements.
Review product dimensions, electrical requirements and installation instructions before purchase.
Installation services are not included unless specifically stated in the product listing.
Our standard return window is 28 days for eligible products.
Statutory rights concerning faulty goods may continue beyond that period.
